Set up your workspace

Create your company Hub and backup service on this Cloud Engine. Follow setup here, then use the one-time claim code to become the Hub owner.

This workspace is already set up.
Hub owners manage software under Hub → Apps → Add app or Updates.
1 · Sign in with Internet Identity. Use the same identity to recover setup progress and claim your Hub.
2 · Enter your setup code. The installer gives you this private, one-time code.
3 · Create the workspace. This creates the Hub and Vault services and connects them.
Your hub is ready.
Open it, sign in with the same identity, and claim it with this code. The code works once; whoever holds it becomes the owner — copy it now, sign in here again to recover it until the hub is claimed.
Setup needs attention.
Review the failed step and keep its details. Reload and sign in with the same identity to recover progress. Before starting again, ask the operator to inspect any services already created; do not delete them without checking for company data.
